status: Integrated in Scene 01; object anchors and depth limitations documented in README.md.

exports.method: Nonzero native layer alpha supplies binary coverage. Every covered pixel copies final manifested base RGBA; raw source layer RGB is never used.
exports.placement_rule: Top-left at (0,0), or a centered Sprite2D at (640,480). Per-object depth sorting is required; do not make all overlays permanently topmost.
